# Parity with Microsoft Office

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask parity` from parity/parity.json; do not edit by hand. -->

This page tracks the features people coming from Microsoft Office would miss, and the ones where Kiln aims to be better. Each row has a would-miss tier (critical, commonly-missed, niche), a delivery priority and a status; a row counts as done only when its named tests pass (`cargo xtask parity --verify`). The rules are in [PLAN.md §7](PLAN.md) and [parity/README.md](parity/README.md).

Tracker updated 2026-10-16. Overall score **38.3 %** over 782 rows in scope (20 out of scope).

Legend: ★ better than Office · ● done · ◐ partial · ○ missing · – out of scope. Score = Σ tier weight × status weight ÷ Σ tier weight over rows in scope, with tier weights critical 3, commonly-missed 2, niche 0.5 and status weights missing 0, partial 0.5, done 1, better 1.

## Better than Office

Rows that exist to be better than Office (no Office equivalent, `office: "—"`) and rows already marked better.

| | Feature | App | Priority | Why it is better |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ○ | Focus mode: distraction-free page with the ribbon hidden | Kiln Write | P0 | a calmer focus mode with typewriter scrolling and a paragraph dim, reachable from the ribbon and the palette |
| ○ | Paste a Markdown table as a styled table | Kiln Write | P0 | Markdown and CSV tables pasted from chat tools and editors become real tables |
| ○ | Stock images hook (configurable provider; no network by default) | Kiln Write | P1 | provider is user-configured and nothing is fetched unless enabled |
| ○ | One-click table of contents from headings | Kiln Write | P0 | one click, kept current on save without a manual update |
| ○ | Callout blocks (note, tip, warning) that export as shaded paragraphs in .docx | Kiln Write | P0 | semantic callouts that degrade to plain Word formatting |
| ○ | Code blocks with syntax highlighting and a monospace style | Kiln Write | P0 | syntax-highlighted code that stays highlighted in the saved .docx |
| ○ | Version history pane: automatic snapshots on save, named versions, diff view, restore | Kiln Write | P0 | version history works for local files with no cloud account and shows a word-level diff |
| ○ | Markdown shortcuts while typing (#, -, 1., **bold**, `code`, ---, >) | Kiln Write | P0 | Markdown habits produce real Word styles and lists |
| ○ | Smart paste: Markdown text becomes headings, lists, emphasis and code | Kiln Write | P0 | pasting Markdown from chat tools gives formatted text, not asterisks |
| ○ | Word-count goal in the status bar with progress | Kiln Write | P0 | a writing target with progress, no add-in |
| ○ | Document outline health: skipped heading levels and empty headings flagged | Kiln Write | P1 | structural checks that also improve accessibility |
| ○ | Export to Markdown and HTML | Kiln Write | P0 | clean Markdown and semantic HTML export built in |
| ○ | Command palette in the ribbon (Ctrl+Shift+P / Alt+Q) with Office synonyms | Kiln Grid | P0 | fuzzy search over every command with Excel's names as synonyms and shortcuts shown |
| ★ | Recommended Charts from the selection's shape | Kiln Grid | P0 | suggestions computed locally from the data shape, previewed live Engine done in WP-73 (kiln-charts: model, layout, rendering, OOXML read/write, SuiteCommand::Chart* editing; ui-kit chart chrome); app wiring and its e2e come with the app surface (Grid WP-71, Deck WP-78). Hosted on Grid sheets in WP-71: inserted from the selection, drawn in the sheet's tiles, selected, moved, resized, edited with Chart Design, Format and the Format pane, undone, and saved to .xlsx. |
| ○ | Formula Lab: formula explainer pane with AST tree and step values | Kiln Grid | P0 | the whole evaluation tree with intermediate values, not one step at a time |
| ◐ | From JSON (array of objects to a table) | Kiln Grid | P0 | Partial: kiln-io-csv (WP-70) reads an array of objects into a table (keys in first-seen order, typed values) through kiln-cli convert and the session; the Data ▸ From JSON command is WP-72 |
| ○ | Version history with cell-level diff | Kiln Grid | P1 | cell-level diff of local files with no cloud account |
| ◐ | Export a range or table as JSON | Kiln Grid | P0 | Partial: kiln-io-csv (WP-70) writes a sheet's first table (or its used range) as an array of objects (kiln-cli convert book.xlsx book.json); exporting a selected range from the UI is WP-72 |
| ○ | Convert a bulleted list to a list diagram (grouped, editable shapes) | Kiln Deck | P1 | unlike Convert to SmartArt, the result is plain grouped shapes that stay editable in every app |
| ○ | Design Ideas pane: layout and theme-variant suggestions for the current slide's content | Kiln Deck | P0 | suggestions computed locally, no cloud service or account |
| ○ | Code block with syntax highlighting | Kiln Deck | P0 | highlighted code that survives the .pptx round trip as formatted text |
| ○ | Live Grid range linked from a workbook | Kiln Deck | P1 | a linked table that refreshes without OLE (§1.4 lists P2; promoted per §7.1) |
| ○ | Present in a browser tab | Kiln Deck | P0 | present from any browser without installing anything |
| ○ | Version history with slide thumbnails per version | Kiln Deck | P0 | snapshots of local files with visual slide diffs, no cloud account |
| ○ | Code block | Kiln Notes | P0 | OneNote has no code blocks at all |
| ○ | Export a page to Markdown | Kiln Notes | P0 | Markdown export for notes |
| ★ | Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P / Alt+Q) with fuzzy search, recent commands and Office synonyms | Suite | P0 | Fuzzy search over every command with Office names and everyday synonyms, shortcuts and recent commands; Office's Tell me has no synonyms or shortcuts. |
| ○ | Shortcut cheat sheet (Ctrl+/) and remappable keyboard page | Suite | P0 | every binding listed and remappable in one place |
| ◐ | Byte-preserving saves: every part not edited is byte-identical after save | Suite | P0 | saving never rewrites what you did not touch (GenOffice's bar, §2A.1). Partial: the package layer repacks every feature fixture byte-identically part by part (WP-55); saves from the apps arrive with the writers (WP-65, WP-70, WP-79); .pptx (WP-79): untouched parts byte-identical on every corpus deck, and session saves with TouchedParts copy untouched slides, layouts, masters and notes pages |
| ○ | Native bundles (.kwrite/.kgrid/.kdeck) with history | Suite | P0 | native files carry their own version history |
| ○ | Version history: snapshots on save, named versions, restore | Suite | P0 | works for local files, no OneDrive or SharePoint |
| ○ | Linux desktop (AppImage, deb) | Suite | P0 | Microsoft 365 has no Linux desktop app |
| ○ | `kiln` CLI: convert, render, inspect, eval, batch | Suite | P0 | headless conversion and inspection without Office installed |
| ○ | JSON control channel over stdio for every command | Suite | P0 | every command scriptable without VBA |
| ○ | MCP server and agent skill over the control channel | Suite | P1 | agents drive Kiln locally; loop round 1 (§7.3) |
| ○ | No telemetry, no account, nothing fetched from third parties | Suite | P0 | no account or telemetry at all |

Out of scope:

| Function | Family | Why |
|---|---|---|
| CALL | add-in | Calls a DLL; native code execution is never offered |
| COPILOT | text | Needs Microsoft's online AI service; Kiln's own AI hooks are off by default, §2.1 |
| CUBEKPIMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBEMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBEMEMBERPROPERTY | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBERANKEDMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBESET | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBESETCOUNT | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| CUBEVALUE | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope, §2A.3 |
| DETECTLANGUAGE | text | Needs Microsoft's online translation service |
| FIELDVALUE | lookup | Needs linked data types from Microsoft's online services |
| FILTERXML | web | Web family, used with WEBSERVICE; out of scope, §2A.3 |
| IMAGE | lookup | Fetches pictures from URLs; network access from formulas is out of scope |
| REGISTER.ID | add-in | Registers a DLL; native code execution is never offered |
| RTD | lookup | Real-time data needs a COM automation server |
| STOCKHISTORY | information | Needs Microsoft's online financial data service |
| TRANSLATE | text | Needs Microsoft's online translation service |
| WEBSERVICE | web | Network access from formulas is out of scope, §2A.3 |
